svg.title: Self-attention: one token gathers context
svg.desc: The token cat supplies a query; every sequence position supplies a key and value. Compare the query with each key, divide by the square root of the key dimension, normalize with softmax, and use the resulting weights to mix values into a context-aware output.

g.text: Each token has a vector x_i.
keys from all positions · K = X W_K
values from all positions · V = X W_V
Same sequence → K and V at
compare the query with each key
Query the sequence → turn similarities into weights → blend the matching values
